name: CR Dhan 801 drought- and submergence-tolerant rice
description: An IRRI and Indian rice institute breeding programme developed CR Dhan 801 (IET 25667) for both drought and temporary submergence. The Swarna-Sub1 line IR05F102 supplied its flood-tolerance background. India notified the variety in April 2019, and a 2023 project trial grew it on a farmer’s field in western Odisha.

places.note: Cuttack and national evaluation; notified states are listed in the event.

date.label: 2015–2016 wet seasons
date.basis: The breeder report identifies the exact line in wet-season national trials in these years.

events.statement: Researchers evaluated the line later designated CR Dhan 801 against Swarna and Swarna-Sub1 in India’s coordinated rice improvement trials.
events.place_note: Participating national trial locations in India.

evidence.locator: Results, “Performance of Selected Promising NILs in the National Trials”, and Figure 3
evidence.supports: Figure 3 links the identified line to specific India wet-season trials and stress conditions.

date.label: 2 April 2019
date.basis: Gazette issue No. 1326 was dated 2 April. Notification S.O. 1498(E) is signed 1 April and specifies effect from publication.

events.statement: India notified CR Dhan 801 (IET 25667) under the Seeds Act for sale in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal.
events.place_note: Five states listed in the notification.

evidence.locator: pp. 9–10, S.O. 1498(E), English table serial 6 spanning page break
evidence.supports: The entry authorizes seed sale in these states. It records no sale or adoption.

evidence.locator: p. 1, Gazette masthead and pp. 9–10, English text preceding the table
evidence.supports: Gives publication date and makes the seed notification effective from publication.

date.label: 2023 kharif
date.basis: Growing season given in the study's experimental-site section.

events.statement: A Kalahandi extension project grew CR Dhan 801 alongside two comparators on one farmer’s field in Khairbhadi during a drought-focused trial.
events.caveats: This is a project trial of performance in drought-prone conditions. It does not record uptake outside the trial.

evidence.supports: Primary trial report identifies the cultivar, farmer’s field, date and comparison.

earliest_record.rationale: The breeder report identifies the line in the 2015–2016 wet-season tests, before formal notification.

links.statement: The CR Dhan 801 programme used IR05F102 as the source of submergence tolerance. This is the Swarna-Sub1 line also designated IR82810-407.
links.scope: The donor line was a sister of IR05F101, the line released in Odisha under the same Swarna-Sub1 name.

evidence.locator: Methods, “Development of NILs in Swarna-Sub1 background”, first paragraph
evidence.supports: The original breeding report names IR05F102.
The developing Indian institute confirms Swarna-Sub1 as a parent in the identified cultivar’s history.
The experimental paper distinguishes the two lines and matches IR05F102 to IR82810-407.
